// Generated by the reference-docs generator from agora's code. Do not edit it by hand: run `agora docs generate` to rewrite it, `agora fresh` to prove it current.

[#reference-commands]
== Command reference

Every command, taken from the registry. `agora command list` and `agora command show COMMAND` say the same, and `agora help` is where the daily work is explained, step by step. A command is `agora NOUN VERB [ID] [options]`; every command takes `--json`, and one that writes takes `--dry-run`.

[cols="1,4"]
|===
|Category |What it may do

|`read`
|changes nothing

|`check`
|verifies, and changes nothing tracked

|`record`
|appends a fact to the tracked record

|`build`
|writes derived output that is not itself the record

|`generate`
|rewrites tracked generated files

|`decision`
|changes what only a person decides: for a person, in the terminal or the editor; never over MCP

|`setup`
|changes the clone's own environment (a lock, a fetched toolchain entry, a running server)

|===

=== Repository-wide commands

These take no noun.

[cols="4,2,2,4"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`agora check [SECTION...] [--scope TEXT] [--suite SUITE] [--changed] [--since TEXT] [--runner RUNNER] [--brand BRAND] [--paragon TEXT] [--mode VOICE_MODE] [--draft] [--spoken]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run checks: sections, a suite, one scope, or only what changed

|`agora context RESOURCE`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Return what an agent needs to work on one resource

|`agora doctor`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Report what agora needs and what is present; fail on registry conflicts

|`agora fresh [GENERATOR...] [--changed]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Prove every generator's tracked output current, writing nothing

|`agora help [TOPIC]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Explain the daily work: the topics, or one topic with its sections and steps, each step a command you can run

|`agora lock [GROUP]`
|setup
|terminal
|Write a group's hashed lock from the packages its manifest pins, through uv

|`agora test`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run agora's own tests with the standard library's runner, under the selftest group's locked packages

=== Typed arguments

A value that fails its type is an error that names the type and gives examples.

[cols="1,3,3"]
|===
|Type |Is |Examples

|`BRAND`
|a brand's slug: a design system with a brand.css (0014-design-systems FR-028)
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`CATEGORY`
|a command category
|read, check, record, build, generate, decision, setup

|`COMMAND`
|a command's words, as `command list` shows them
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`COMMIT`
|a full Git commit, 40 hex digits
|8efca19779828488b21619777e5f7805ca22c2bb

|`CONTROL`
|a control as <catalog>:<control>, as the ontology's control catalogs declare them
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`COURSE_TARGET`
|what a course is built to: a static site, an Open edX export or a cmi5 package
|web, olx, cmi5

|`DATE`
|a date as YYYY-MM-DD
|2026-10-04

|`DESIGN_SYSTEM`
|a design system's slug, a directory of design-systems/
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`ENTRY`
|a toolchain entry, as `toolchain list` names them: tinytex, chromium, ...
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`GENERATOR`
|a generator, as `fresh` proves it: brand-theme, brand-specimen, ...
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`GROUP`
|a command group
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`INK`
|an ink of a brand's decoration kit as <brand>/<role>, such as frontiers-brand/primary
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`KIND`
|a design system kind code of the ontology's kind scheme, such as web or brand
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`KIT_PART`
|which part of the decoration kit: trace (the lockup and icon) or set (the wordmark and unit marks)
|trace, set

|`LAYOUT`
|a print layout's name or alias, from layouts.json: two-column, nature, jama
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`MECHANISM`
|how a requirement is enforced (0020 FR-012)
|check, gate, review, none

|`PATH`
|a path to a file or directory that exists, relative to where the command runs
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`PIECE`
|an imagery piece as <brand>/<piece>, such as frontiers-brand/fog-coast-lighthouse-footbridge
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`PROPOSAL`
|a proposal as NNNN-slug, as `proposal list` shows them
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`PROPOSAL_STATUS`
|whether a proposal is open or accepted
|open, accepted

|`REQUIREMENT`
|a requirement as <spec>/FR-NNN, such as 0020/FR-013
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`RESOURCE`
|a resource as kind:id, such as spec:0020 or requirement:0020/FR-013
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`RUNNER`
|which harness: browser or python for design-systems; node or vscode for extension
|browser, python, node, vscode

|`SCHEME`
|a concept scheme of the ontology by its local name, such as CommandCategoryScheme
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`SECTION`
|a check section, as `command show check` lists them
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`SLUG`
|lowercase words joined by hyphens
|agora, command-line

|`SPEC`
|a spec as NNNN-slug or NNNN, or a design system's slug
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`SPEC_STATUS`
|a spec's status (0020 FR-009)
|Draft, Adopted, Superseded

|`SUITE`
|a named set of check sections
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`TERM`
|a concept or scheme of the ontology by its local name, such as ReadCommandCategory
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`TOPIC`
|a help topic, as `help` lists them: start, check, specs, ...
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`VARIANT`
|a figure color variant of frontiers-figures: default, on-dark or grayscale
|a value `the noun's list command` offers

|`VOICE_MODE`
|how the voice sweep reads a text: as prose or as a procedure's steps
|prose, procedure
